dispositions.rationale: Cursor registration, model, and runtime metadata is intentionally excluded; PK-Stack ships Kiro-native Power and agent manifests instead.
Upstream catalog and release prose was used to reconcile inventory and provenance; executable semantics are accounted for in the affected packages and guides.
The unavailable upstream raster and Cursor branding are excluded; PK-Stack uses an independently generated potato-ghost asset.
Verification, review, freshness, and authorization-gated shipping semantics were adapted to projectctl and current-session Kiro workflows.
Unattended supervision and recovery semantics were adapted to the fail-closed scheduled Kiro and GitHub maintenance lane.
Architecture scaffold, signature, rationale, interface-depth, red-flag, and verification contracts were adapted to the Kiro-native architect route.
Isolated candidates, shared rubric, lead adjudication, coherent grafting, and final proof were retained with Kiro subagents.
Grounded explanation and explicit critique mode were retained without Cursor task metadata.
Independent correctness, code-quality, and lead-judgment review rubrics were adapted to bounded Kiro evidence packets.
Cursor and Grok routines, secret-card APIs, cursor.sh, automatic sudo, and Tailscale side effects are excluded; docs expose a safe manual architecture path.
The complete workflow router, visible skips, verification lifecycle, review council, and safe authorization boundaries were adapted to Kiro.
Long-horizon implementation, checkpoint, independent review, repair, and terminal verdict semantics were retained in current-session Kiro form.
Risk-first independently landable phases, base-chain validation, and freshness proof were retained without Cursor runtime control.
Durable supervision, stable patch-id freshness after rebases, bounded recovery, and explicit terminal outcomes were adapted to Kiro.
Reproduction, root-cause repair, regression proof, and independent review sequencing were retained.
Baseline measurement, one-variable improvements, evidence checkpoints, and rollback discipline were retained.
Risk-first phases, explicit predicates, independently verifiable units, and checkpoint semantics were retained.
GitHub CLI default, optional Origin capability, early ready durable PR checkpoint, and separate PR authorization were retained; Graphite and unsafe rewrites were excluded.
Measured baseline, representative workload, profile-driven repair, and regression thresholds were retained.
Bottom-up shipping, base and head identity binding, patch-id freshness, CI and mergeability reproof, and separately gated landing were retained.
Finding classification, evidence-based adjudication, and fail-closed unresolved-review handling were adapted to the reviewer council.
Three independent reflection lenses, synthesis, and approval before durable project-local edits were retained.
Setup outcome was retained as idempotent Kiro bootstrap, discovery validation, inherited selected model and effort, and optional verification offer; fixed Cursor role models were dropped.
TypeScript discipline was retained as an on-demand skill plus Kiro fileMatch steering for TypeScript and TSX files.
Concrete TypeScript patterns were adapted into the full skill reference and concise pervasive steering contract.
Scan, rewrite, add-soul, pattern catalog, and self-audit semantics were retained in the full route plus an always-on concise core.
Parallel source-category investigation, coverage and gap accounting, confidence, and bounded external evidence packets were retained.
The upstream version-only change is Cursor registration metadata; PK-Stack retains its independently versioned Kiro Power manifest.
The unavailable upstream raster and Cursor branding remain excluded; PK-Stack retains its independently generated potato-ghost mascot.
